propositions: GitHub code-scanning alert #88 flags bare substring containment (in operator) in upstream-URL assertion as incomplete URL sanitization; the check accepts lookalike hosts (e.g., https://pandoc.org.evil.com, https://notpandoc.org)

The test asserts that NOTICE mentions upstream source to satisfy GPL source-availability obligation, but substring checks do not anchor the host boundary, allowing suffix and prefix lookalike domains to pass

A scheme+host-anchored regex with explicit end-of-host negative lookahead boundary ((?![\w.-]) after pandoc.org, (?![\w-]) after github path) rejects both lookalike classes while accepting real NOTICE URLs (https://pandoc.org, http://www.pandoc.org, https://github.com/jgm/pandoc)

The fix replaces the two separate substring checks with a single compiled regex module-level constant and assertion, touching only the upstream-URL assertion logic without modifying version pins or NOTICE content
